title: [board] TRADE-CARD-DECISION-REVIEW — Clear method results and reliable basket/broker review
body:
[codex]

**Phase id:** `TRADE-CARD-DECISION-REVIEW` · **Design / spec:** approved trade-card information-flow and submission-review requirements below · **Decision:** user approved design and requested Board publication in this chat.
**Branch:** `board/trade-card-decision-review-95403959`
**Blocked by:** publication wiring — native child/dependency links require an authenticated capability unavailable in this session. Textual child/dependency links will be recorded; do not start execution until native wiring is installed.
**Touches:** Options trade-card UI, method results, basket tracking, broker request review, existing position-write normalization and associated regression coverage.

## Goal
Make the options trade card readable and give the trader a reliable review of exactly what goes to Portfolio tracking versus a named broker.

## Approved scope
- Large strike, call/put and expiry; full Contract Details visible. Preserve chart jump, navigation and all existing controls.
- Market Sentiment above the card; Fundamental Health directly below, retaining badge colors, scores and full definitions.
- One editable Exit Plan with clear actual position settings, premium loss/remaining value and units, and collapsed-by-default explanatory/ATR/structure text. Consistent editable-field styling.
- Monte Carlo remains explicitly triggered. Harmonize all methods, show every existing target row with its own probability/time, support equal-height two/three-method comparison.
- Ladder shows shared Exit Plan stops with source labels; only unavailable method-specific stock-stop valuations say not calculated. Keep full-position/rung outcomes distinct and preserve full-premium R:R.
- Barrier Race graphic and numeric shares use the same existing weights. Preserve all explanatory copy, inputs, controls, stale/error/conditional states and pricing assumptions.
- Clearly distinguish model inputs/results from actual position settings, current-time stop-cost from barrier-time valuation, and target-touch probability from target-before-stops attribution.
- Choose method/target and review the effective submission/alert basis, stops, contract, quantity, applicable entry semantics, existing probability/time and quantity-based totals. Preserve optional-row behavior and clearly disclose any fallback.
- Pinning remains a symbol selection, not a frozen trade or order. Tracking review must account for actual server normalization and saved rows; broker review must distinguish requested values, unknown future fills and later adjustments.
- No new pricing model, automatic application of model stops, protective-order behavior or real trading during validation.

## Implementation sequence
Nine child tickets will be linked in the publication comment, with full acceptance criteria and explicit blockers. Ticket 01 reconciles the actual running build because supplied screenshots contain elements absent from the inspected checkout. Do not assume old line numbers, placeholder quotes or illustrative preview prices are live fixtures.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Every existing field, badge, color, tooltip, explanatory text and conditional control accounted for in a before/after register.
- [ ] Initial, restored, calculated, stale and edited states readable and numerically consistent.
- [ ] Basket review matches tracked requested/effective values without silent substitution; tracking creates no broker order.
- [ ] Broker request matches its review; real fill/persistence adjustments explicitly reconciled.
- [ ] Existing pricing, stop/alert semantics, validation, migrations, performance and auto-trade behavior preserved unless separately approved.
- [ ] Appropriate tests plus independent phase-level plan/code audits pass under the repository's numeric/persistence gate and three-round-per-stage cap.

## Ratings and evidence
**Completion:** 20% — concrete nine-ticket plan independently reviewed by fresh reviewer `ticket_breakdown_audit`; zero numeric/persistence gate findings and no agreed-requirement omissions. Code implementation, regression retests and code audit have not started.
**Size:** XL (>16 engineering hours across the phase). **Complexity:** 4 — multiple asynchronous calculation bases, tracking persistence, backend normalization and broker request/outcome parity.
**Rationale:** This phase combines preservation-sensitive presentation with cross-boundary submission review; it cannot be delivered reliably as a frontend recap alone.
**Next unmet milestone:** reconcile the running revision and implement the reviewed slices after board-native wiring and phase ownership are established.

## Publication limitation
The CLI token fails authentication. The connected GitHub integration can publish issues/comments but does not expose native sub-issue/dependency writes. Keep this phase blocked until a properly authenticated agent installs and verifies the native edges. Do not substitute a local tracker. Do not edit the Board #151 body; announce this publication by a tagged Board comment.
